rule: Land-grant exile cast windows are Layer-1 future permissions and termination conditions — NO Layer-2 cast gold

policyDistinction.future_specific_object_permission: You may cast [Card] for as long as it remains exiled → Layer 1 permission (objectScope=specific_object, duration=while_condition)
policyDistinction.termination_condition: until [Card] is cast from exile → Layer 1 condition / future-event reference — NOT cast primitive
policyDistinction.one_shot_contrast: You may cast that card. / You may cast the copy. → resolution completes with opportunity → Layer-2 cast only when permission does NOT persist beyond resolution
